title: Google updates AI Mode and AI Overviews to add "a preview of perspectives" from firsthand sources like social media and Reddit, presented as "Expert Advice" (Jess Weatherbed/The Verge)
summary: Jess Weatherbed / The Verge: Google updates AI Mode and AI Overviews to add “a preview of perspectives” from firsthand sources like social media and Reddit, presented as “Expert Advice” — The new AI Mode and AI Overviews updates bring in perspectives from firsthand sources like social media and web forums.
contentText:
Jess Weatherbed / The Verge :

Google updates AI Mode and AI Overviews to add “a preview of perspectives” from firsthand sources like social media and Reddit, presented as “Expert Advice”   —  ﻿The new AI Mode and AI Overviews updates bring in perspectives from firsthand sources like social media and web forums.
